headline: Standing best 2634.58 output TPS (DSpark b16, true S2 @8192) — original 2500 target crossed. Active campaign: 3000 output TPS via int5/int4 W4A16 + decode-side levers (quality-gated).

campaigns.name: DSpark draft vs S2 MTP-assistant — same stack/greedy, draft-only swap
campaigns.notes: Matched-workload proof FIRST (boxed 768, apples-to-apples): DSpark b16 (1866.46 TPS / QPS 2.98) beats S2 MTP-assistant k5 (1798.22 TPS / QPS 2.87) by +3.8% — correcting an earlier mis-verdict. True-S2 DSpark run decoded ~2295 tok/req (8192 cap) at 2634.58 TPS / QPS 1.15 in 871s. LENGTH-MISMATCH CAVEAT on the new MTP @8192 control: it decoded only ~1323 tok/req (output_tps 2434.38 / qps 1.84) vs DSpark's ~2291 tok/req, so the raw TPS/QPS delta is NOT apples-to-apples despite the shared output_len=8192 in config. DSpark's 2634.58 stands on its own as a crossing of the original 2500 target; the true-8192 fractional advantage over MTP remains UNPROVEN until a genuinely length-matched (>=2295 tok/req) MTP control lands. 3000 is the active target (Sec 3.4 lever matrix).
